method: One stationary normal-world scene, same saved world and fixed camera. Separate processes. 35-second warmup at 24 chunks, 12-second warmup at 16 chunks, 6-second samples. Entities remain alive. VSync off. Stock textures, clouds off. Metal renders every measured frame; bounded presentation can drop superseded screen submissions.
baseline: SodiumMac 3.5.1, SpeedrunAPI 2.2, LazyDFU 0.1.2, Minecraft OpenGL; no WineMetalGL.
metal_mods: Fabric loader, Meshnet direct Metal, Loom native support. No Sodium.
validation: Clean Java/native build and existing frame-pacing tests passed.
An earlier packed indirect build passed Metal API and shader validation; final face-group/shading/translucency changes were validated in the normal-world benchmark without debug layers.
Final normal-world scene and glowing-entity effect rendered and exited normally.
24-chunk Metal and OpenGL captures visually inspected; geometry, foliage and water present.
No OpenGL context is created; constructor verifies GLFW current context is zero.
Final package build and existing automated checks passed after readback-format handling was completed.
limitations: One short scene per distance is not a universal FPS guarantee.
No 14-, 20-, or 32-chunk measurements; no walking, dimension-tour, or full modpack suite.
The 16-chunk maximum frame was 23.82 ms versus 19.89 ms in the OpenGL reference, despite the improved p99.
Normal vanilla rendering and stock shader programs are targeted. Modified GLSL shader packs and direct OpenGL mods require integration.
Original Prism instances and mods were not changed.
architecture: Persistent GPU terrain arena, 16-byte common vertices and full-precision fallback.
GPU frustum/portal visibility and conservative face-group culling.
Indexed indirect opaque/cutout layers; separately batched sorted translucent layers.
Specialized fragment pipelines and terrain vertex lightmap sampling.
Batched animation uploads, triple-buffered staging and bounded asynchronous presentation.
Native Metal render targets, textures, entity/UI draws, and 28 build-time stock shader-effect pairs.
